The essentials

✈Before you goPassport, flights, insurance
  • Passport valid six months past May 24. No visa needed for US citizens.
  • Flights are booked on your own. Send Dominique your arrival time so she can plan pickups.
  • Travel insurance with medical coverage is required. Buy it by April 9, or within two weeks of your deposit if you want Cancel for Any Reason coverage.
  • Add an international plan or eSIM. US carriers charge roaming there.
$MoneyCash, tips, prices
  • US dollars, and cards work almost everywhere.
  • Bring about $100 in small bills for Fish Fry vendors, the water taxi and tips.
  • Many restaurants add a 10 to 15% service charge, so check before tipping.
  • Cocktails usually run $15 to $20.
⌂Getting homeMonday, May 24
  • Checkout is 11:30 AM. We leave for the airport at 2:30 PM.
  • Questions anytime? Text Dominique.

FAQ

Quick answers
How do I RSVP and pay?

Open the link Dominique sent and sign in. Tap RSVP and add your name. Then go to the Pay screen and tap Pay with Stripe for your $200 deposit within 7 days. Come back to the Pay screen for each payment, tap Pay with Stripe, and check it off. Dominique confirms each one on her end. Once your deposit is in, you're added to the group chat when it goes live in December.

What does my share cover?

The villa, the private boat to Noah's Ark, car service for every ride, the grocery fund, the clear kayak tour and the chef brunch. The full list is on the Pay screen. Flights, dinners out and optional add-ons are on you.

Do I have to share a room?

It depends on the villa that wins. Rooms are assigned once it's booked, and requests go first come, first served by deposit. Add yours in your RSVP notes.

Can I bring a plus one?

Yes, as long as they're 21 or older. There are two ways. Your plus one can open the same link, RSVP as themselves and pay their own share. Or check the plus one box on your RSVP to pay for both of you, which doubles your deposit and payments. Either way, Dominique confirms there's space.

When is everything due?

A $200 deposit within 7 days of your RSVP, then four payments on the 9th of January, February, March and April. Just be all paid up by April 9. A $75 refundable damage deposit is due with that last payment and comes back by June 8. If you need more time on a payment, talk to Dominique early.

Why is the share an estimate?

The price depends on whether we end up at 6 or 8. It's locked on December 31, before the first payment, so nobody gets surprise charges later.

What if I'm on a different flight?

No problem. Land by 4:00 PM Wednesday to catch the group pickup. If you arrive later or leave on a different day, your airport ride for that leg is on you.

Do I have to do everything?

Not at all. Every night out is optional, and the add-ons on the Plan screen are opt-in. Hang at the pool whenever you want.

What if the weather is bad?

If weather affects a boat day, we'll move things around and keep the trip just as good.

Do I need travel insurance?

Yes, it's required, and it has to include medical coverage, since most US health plans don't work abroad. Buy it by April 9 and check the box on your Pay screen. It usually runs 4 to 10% of what you've prepaid and covers cancelling for reasons like illness or a family emergency. If you want to be able to cancel for any reason, look for a Cancel for Any Reason upgrade and buy it within two weeks of your deposit.

Guidelines

How we share the trip
Sharing the villaRooms, bathrooms, kitchen
  • Your room, your stuff. Keep your things in your room or space, and ask before borrowing anything.
  • Bathrooms are shared. Keep showers quick before dinners and nights out, and don't leave your products all over the counter.
  • Clean as you go. Rinse your dishes, toss your cups and wipe up spills. Groceries from the group fund are for everyone.
  • Quiet hours. Keep it down after 1 AM so early sleepers can rest, and respect the neighbors and house rules.
  • No outside guests at the villa without checking with the group and the host first.
  • Pool safety. No glass by the pool, and nobody swims alone after drinking.
  • Smoking or vaping happens outside, only where the house rules allow it.
  • Lock up. The last one out locks the door. Lost keys or fobs are charged to whoever lost them.
  • Checkout is a group job. Everyone helps with dishes, trash and the host's checkout list Monday morning.
On the goRides, plans, safety
  • Booked times are firm. Be ready 10 minutes before every car pickup. The boat and tours leave on time.
  • Skipping something? Drop a note in the group chat so nobody waits.
  • Nobody drives. We use the car services, and we head out at night in pairs or more.
  • Watch out for each other. Nobody gets left at a bar or the beach. Check the group chat before leaving anywhere.
  • Be kind to locals and staff, and tip the people who take care of us.
Group vibesMoney, photos, keeping it fun
  • Settle up fast. Pay your share of dinners and drinks within 24 hours of the request.
  • Ask before posting. Get the okay before sharing someone's photos or stories.
  • Early birds and night owls are both welcome. Do your thing without waking or rushing anyone.
  • If something feels off, talk to Dominique privately so it doesn't turn into group drama.
  • Every plan is optional, but the vibe isn't. Bring good energy.

    Terms, waiver and policies
    By March 15, 2027Full refund of everything you've paid, deposit included.
    March 16 to April 1Your excursions, car service and grocery fund are refunded, except the private boat to Noah's Ark. Your share of the villa is not.
    After April 1No refunds. Bookings are final at that point.
    1. What this is
    • Trippin in Turks is a private trip among friends. Dominique Jenkins ("the organizer") coordinates a shared villa rental and group bookings as a private individual. She is not a travel agency, tour operator or seller of travel.
    • Your share covers your portion of costs at cost. The organizer makes no profit from it.
    • This trip is 21+. You must be 21 or older to join, and you confirm you are by agreeing to these terms. Plus ones must be 21 or older too.
    2. Payments and refunds
    • Your place is held once your $200 deposit is in. It's due within 7 days of your RSVP. The balance is due in four payments, with everything paid by April 9, 2027.
    • The share is an estimate until December 31, 2026, when it's set based on the final headcount.
    • To cancel, text Dominique. Your cancellation date is the day she receives your message. Refunds follow the schedule above and go back to the card you paid with. Card processing fees aren't refundable.
    • No refunds for missed activities, leaving early, arriving late, or being denied boarding or entry.
    • A $75 refundable damage deposit per person is due with the April 9 payment and is returned by June 8, 2027 if no damage claims are filed.
    3. Damage and charges
    • You're responsible for any damage, extra cleaning, lost keys, broken items or fines you or your plus one cause at the villa, on a boat, in a car or with any vendor.
    • The villa is booked in the organizer's name, so charges land on her first. You agree to repay anything you caused in full within 14 days of being asked. Your damage deposit goes toward it first.
    • Damage nobody owns up to is split equally and comes out of everyone's deposit.
    • If you don't pay what you owe, the organizer may recover it through any lawful means, including small claims court, and you agree to pay reasonable costs of collection.
    4. Your responsibilities
    • Your passport, entry requirements, flights and travel documents are your responsibility.
    • You're responsible for your own health, medications, allergies and drinking. Travel insurance with medical coverage is required for everyone, including plus ones, and must be bought by April 9, 2027. Anyone without it may not be able to join the trip, and refunds still follow the schedule above.
    • You follow the villa's house rules, local laws, and the instructions of captains, guides and drivers, and you agree to each vendor's own terms and waivers.
    • If your conduct puts anyone at risk or breaks house rules, you may be asked to leave the villa or an activity, with no refund.
    • Every plus one must agree to these terms and sign, either on your RSVP or by RSVPing on their own. If you RSVP for a plus one, you're also responsible for their conduct, payments and any damage they cause.
    5. Assumption of risk and release
    • Travel, boats, kayaks, jet cars, swimming, snorkeling, sun, alcohol and nights out carry risks, known and unknown, including injury, illness and loss of property. You join every activity voluntarily and accept those risks.
    • To the fullest extent allowed by law, you release the organizer from any claims for injury, illness, death, loss, damage, delay or expense connected to the trip, except those caused by her gross negligence or willful misconduct.
    • Boats, tours, drivers, restaurants and the villa are run by independent companies. The organizer isn't responsible for their acts, failures or safety.
    • The organizer isn't responsible for changes, delays or cancellations caused by weather, airlines, vendors, illness, government action or anything else outside her control. Plans may change when needed.
    • In an emergency, you allow the group to seek medical help for you. Any medical costs are yours.
    6. Indemnity and limits
    • You agree to cover the organizer's losses and reasonable costs, including legal fees, if a claim is made against her because of your actions or your plus one's.
    • If the organizer is ever found responsible for anything, her total liability is limited to the amount you paid her for the trip.
    7. Agreement
    • Checking the box and signing your RSVP is your electronic signature and means you've read, understood and agree to these terms. A record of your agreement is kept.
    • These terms are governed by the laws of Virginia. If any part can't be enforced, the rest still applies.
    • Questions about any of this? Ask Dominique before you RSVP.

    Host tools

    Add your Stripe link, confirm payments, and add photos from any card.

    Stripe payment links

    One link per amount. Turn on "Let customers adjust quantity" in Stripe so plus ones can choose 2.

    Chargeback protection setup
    • In your Stripe Payment Link, turn on Require customers to accept your terms of service and use this site's link as the terms URL.
    • Collect each payer's name, email and phone, and add a custom field for the name they used on this site.
    • Set your statement descriptor to something they'll recognize, like TRIPPIN TURKS, so nobody disputes a charge they don't recognize.
    • Leave email receipts on. If someone disputes a charge, upload their Record PDF from the guest list below, plus the Stripe receipt, as your evidence.
    Guest list access

    Only emails on this list can sign in and see the trip. Add each friend and plus one here, then send them the site link.
